svg.title: Java thread models: platform threads vs virtual threads
svg.desc: Three diagrams showing platform thread 1:1 mapping, virtual thread mounting, and blocking behavior comparison
svg.text: Before Java 21 — platform threads (1:1 with OS)
Each Java thread = 1 OS thread = ~1 MB stack. Max ~thousands.
After Java 21 — virtual threads (N:M with OS)
OS knows ONLY about carrier threads. Virtual threads are invisible to the OS.
What happens when a thread blocks on I/O
~1 MB stack still alive, doing nothing
